lines.text: 没有比武士更孤独的东西，也许只有丛林里的老虎。
lines.en: There is no greater solitude than that of the samurai, unless perhaps that of the tiger in the jungle.
lines.note: 片首引语的通行译法；为杰夫的职业伦理与绝对孤独定调。
